visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair, wearing a white t-shirt and a black jacket, sits in a living room with a gray sofa and a wooden shelf in the background. He holds a square physical music album in a plastic sleeve, showcasing the front cover which features his own photo. (2) He turns the album to the back, revealing a matte black surface with white line-drawn human figures and track titles. He uses his fingers to trace the illustrations, highlighting the design details under warm, bright indoor lighting that creates slight glares on the plastic. (3) The man unfolds a large, multi-paneled black paper poster that serves as a lyrics sheet. It depicts a black-and-white image of him running on a dark road. He holds it up with both hands, moving it side-to-side to show the scale and the printed lyrics on the reverse side. (4) He carefully opens a black paper CD sleeve and slides out a black disc. The CD surface features white silhouettes of two hands reaching toward the center. He holds the disc up to his face, looking through the center hole and smiling. (5) The camera returns to a medium shot of the man talking directly to the viewer, gesturing with his hands and holding the album. He exhibits high-arousal facial expressions, wide eyes, and a broad smile, showing deep satisfaction with the product. (6) A fast-paced montage sequence begins, showing extreme close-ups and artistic arrangements of the album parts. The CD, the poster, and the packaging are displayed on a wooden table and pinned to a white wall alongside other artwork and a green fern plant.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with an enthusiastic male voice speaking at a fast pace with a high pitch, conveying extreme excitement. There is no BGM, only clean studio-quality speech with a faint rustling of plastic as he handles the album package. (2) A background music track fades in, featuring a rhythmic acoustic guitar and soft piano chords. A distinct 'click' sound marks a transition as the speaker's tone shifts to a narrative style while explaining the back cover design. (3) Large paper rustling sounds are clearly audible as the poster is unfolded. The BGM evolves to include male vocals singing in a gentle pop-ballad style, harmonizing with the main speaker's energetic commentary. (4) The sound of the CD being removed from its sleeve creates a sliding friction noise. The speaker laughs softly, and high-pitched 'ding' and 'pop' sound effects are inserted to sync with on-screen text overlays. (5) The speaker expresses gratitude with a warm, sincere tone. The BGM singing continues, becoming more prominent as the speaker's vocal density decreases. Occasional finger snaps or slight thuds from placing the items are heard. (6) A final montage phase features an instrumental-heavy mix of the BGM with strong beat synchronization. Sharp 'whoosh' sound effects accompany the rapid visual transitions between different close-ups of the album components.
